name: offerbound-ai-job-search
description: Root task shortcuts. Each runs the matching task in backend/ (uv + poe) and frontend/ (npm).

scripts.setup: cd backend && uv sync && cd ../frontend && npm ci
scripts.dev:backend: cd backend && uv run poe dev
scripts.lint: cd backend && uv run poe lint && uv run poe format-check && cd ../frontend && npm run lint
scripts.typecheck: cd backend && uv run poe typecheck && cd ../frontend && npm run typecheck
scripts.test: cd backend && uv run poe test && cd ../frontend && npm test
scripts.check: cd backend && uv run poe check && cd ../frontend && npm run check && npm run build
